name: Dover
description: Dover is a holding company of about five clusters of niche industrial businesses: vehicle-repair equipment, fuel dispensers and car-wash systems, industrial marking and coding printers, specialty pumps and plastics-processing equipment (including data-centre liquid-cooling connectors), and commercial refrigeration and heat exchangers. Each business sells equipment, then follows with consumables, parts, software and service (marking and coding, for example, sells printers then ink). Dover grows by acquiring and sometimes divesting small niche leaders; its segments earn between about 17 and 30 percent margins.

businessLines.name: Engineered Products
businessLines.how: Sells vehicle lifts, wheel service, diagnostics and collision-repair equipment to garages (one-time equipment plus software and service), and winches, hoists, aerospace and defense components, precision soldering and dispensing gear through distributors and direct.

businessLines.name: Clean Energy & Fueling
businessLines.how: Sells fuel dispensers, payment and monitoring systems, underground containment, cryogenic and hydrogen components, EV chargers and vehicle-wash systems to fuel retailers and operators (equipment plus recurring parts, software and service).

businessLines.name: Imaging & Identification
businessLines.how: Razor-and-blade: an initial sale of marking and coding printers, traceability and digital textile printing equipment, followed by recurring inks, consumables, software and service revenue.

businessLines.name: Pumps & Process Solutions
businessLines.how: Sells specialty and single-use pumps, flow meters, fluid connectors (including liquid cooling for data-centre servers and chips), plastics and polymer processing equipment and rotating-machinery instrumentation to biopharma, chemicals, thermal management and energy customers, through distributors and OEMs; equipment plus aftermarket parts.

businessLines.name: Climate & Sustainability Technologies
businessLines.how: Sells commercial refrigeration systems, display cases and glass doors to food retailers, brazed plate heat exchangers for heat pumps and industrial use, and aluminium can-making equipment: large project and equipment sales to retailers and manufacturers.
